correctness.rationale: Belletti--Detcherry Corollary 6.2(2) applies to every compact oriented \(M\) embedding in a rational homology sphere and gives an infinite connected hyperbolic family, all \((Y_k,T_n)\)-equivalent to \(M\), with \(M_i\) not embedding in \(M_j\) for every \(i\ne j\). Set \(k=d+1\). By definition, \((Y_{d+1},T_n)\)-equivalence implies \(Y_{d+1}\)-equivalence. Massuyeau Proposition 3.32 then forces equality under every finite-type invariant of degree at most \(d\) on the common \(Y_1\)-class. No converse, computational extrapolation, or infinite verification step is used.

value.rationale: The result identifies a structural limitation of an entire hierarchy of invariants, not a single example: for every prescribed finite degree, all invariants in that range are simultaneously constant on an infinite hyperbolic antichain for embeddability. This sharpens the interpretation of the recent non-embedding theorem by showing that the obstruction responsible for the antichain necessarily lies beyond every fixed finite-type layer chosen in advance.
